model: claude-opus-5-5 (every assistant message in every transcript, except one follow-up launch on Claude Sonnet 5.5 that is reported apart)
harness: Claude Code 2.1.318 subagents, one per team, each in its own workspace; isolation by instruction, audited

arms.scaffold-v6: plus scaffold v6 (CLAUDE.md, 10 skills, 4 subagents, 2 hooks): experiments/2026-11/scaffolds_as_run/v6
arms.scaffold-v7: plus scaffold v7 (v6 + answer-the-brief skill, coverage rules): experiments/2026-11/scaffolds_as_run/v7; designed after seeing hidden A errors, so only hidden B is a clean test for it

full_set.note: one trial per packet, same prompt (prompts/agent_briefs/direct_trial2.md); 143 packets

repeat_sample.note: 40 packets answered twice by independent agents; trial 1 prompt did not mention Glob

direct.note: agents of 5 (sample) or 7 (rest) packets each, tools limited to Read/Write/Edit/Glob, answer written by hand as JSON

examples_followup.note: same 40 packets and groups of 5; 16 fresh subagents started together; control = trial-2 brief, examples = the same plus three solved examples from examples.jsonl; both briefs name the five packet files (no Glob tool in that Claude Code build)

sonnet_run.note: second launch: the same two briefs ran on Sonnet 5.5 because the session's default subagent model was Sonnet; kept as a within-Sonnet comparison, not the pre-registered test

teaching_followup.runtime: claude -p (headless Claude Code 2.1.319), claude-opus-5-5, one session per group and arm

judge2.labels: X=B, Y=A (swapped to expose label bias)

list_prices_usd_per_mtok.note: added 2026-11-06 for the cost comparison; list prices, not what the study paid
list_prices_usd_per_mtok.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (read 2026-11-06); cache reads on Claude Opus 5.5 are 0.05x the base input price, per the page's footnote
